policy.stableFields: RaenonX raw mechanics are compared against the pre-sync API baseline.
policy.localizedFields: RaenonX owns en/fr/es/pt/zh names and rules for this sync.
policy.images: RaenonX owns the four newly added localized image variants; existing English R2 objects are preserved.

pinnedCardImage.role: primary visual evidence and production image

boosterAssets.role: production booster logo and front artwork

index.role: number, name, rarity, and image index

deckGym.role: mechanics validation candidate only; content is not copied without card review

pokeOS.role: independent count, numbering, rarity, and set-name validation; de/it localized production image source
pokeOS.limitation: B4 per-card localized name and mechanics fields remain null and the public Master.json path returns 404; used for reviewed de/it images, not structured localized metadata.

raenonX.role: source-exact localized names, attack/ability/trainer text, and localized card-image candidate
raenonX.limitation: No formal repository licence was found; use is limited to the user's authorized, attributed direct mirror. It does not provide the project's de/it B4 localization.

cardImageOcr.role: illustrator, flavor, and targeted conflict evidence

pokemonZone.role: four targeted ambiguous illustrator checks only
pokemonZone.limitation: Terms prohibit scraper use, so it was not used for batch ingestion.

pokeApi.role: official franchise species, move, ability, and Pokédex flavor localization lookup

tcgDex.limitation: B4 endpoints returned 404 in all target languages during this run.
